title: Per-agent id-family contract: agents declare/emit only registered families (no invented prefixes)
body: config/spec-id-families.json gains `emits` per agent (allowed families). id_index.emits_for/registered_prefixes/undeclared_ids added. prompt_builder._spec_id_convention(agent_id) injects the agent's allowed families into every spec prompt ('define ONLY these; never invent a prefix'). Registered the real agent families discovered: KF, M, N, G, R (ideation risks), ADR, CMP, DM, T, V, OQ, TC, SEC, FIND, SLO, INC, DS, A11Y, VO, BI.
